To defend under Mastercard 4837, the merchant must satisfy any two of four requirements: full AVS and CVV match, successful 3DS authentication, two prior undisputed transactions with matching billing details in the past 12 months, or signed proof of delivery to the billing address.

The transaction record shows 3DS status not_attempted. The merchant provides no authentication evidence.

workup.rationale: Transaction txn_7762GH for £87.40 failed both AVS (N) and CVV (N), and 3D Secure was not attempted. The merchant's only evidence is an internal fraud screening report. It assigns a low risk score based on amount, MCC and time of day but contains none of the compelling evidence Mastercard 4837 requires. That report also records the customer as new on their first transaction, so no prior undisputed transaction history exists, and signed proof of delivery does not apply to a digital purchase. None of the four requirements is met, so liability is accepted.
workup.action_justification: Zero of four requirements can be met: AVS/CVV failed, 3DS was not attempted, there is no prior history, and there is no physical delivery. None of this can be remedied after the fact.
caveats: The internal fraud report is the merchant's own risk assessment. Its LOW score and statement that the merchant is 'confident this transaction is legitimate' are not compelling evidence under 4837.
The report is dated 12 May 2025, after the chargeback was raised on 11 May 2025. It was prepared for the dispute and is not a contemporaneous record.
Fraud indicators in the record support the issuer's claim: a new, previously unseen device fingerprint, a first-time customer account, a 03:42 UTC transaction time, and failed AVS/CVV.
The IP address 45.227.255.103 should be geolocated against the GB card BIN country. A mismatch would further support the fraud claim.
Consider flagging the merchant for enabling 3DS on card-not-present transactions and declining AVS/CVV failures, to avoid repeat liability.

rule_text:
Mastercard 4837 - No Cardholder Authorisation
Issuer claim: Cardholder denies authorising the transaction (card-not-present fraud equivalent).
Logic: Any TWO of the 4 requirements must be satisfied.
Compelling evidence requirements:
  1. AVS match (full address) AND CVV match on the disputed transaction
  2. 3D Secure authentication completed successfully (Mastercard SecureCode / Identity Check)
  3. Two prior undisputed transactions from the same cardholder with this merchant in the past 12 months, with matching billing details
  4. Proof of delivery to the cardholder's billing address with signature
prechecks: AVS: N (no match); CVV: N (no match); 3DS: not_attempted
Shipping vs billing postcode: no shipping postcode on file (digital goods or service)
Chargeback raised 12 days after the transaction
Flag: both AVS and CVV failed on the disputed transaction
